Cleave: Can make an extra attack after causing a foe to drop
Combat Expertise: Can suffer up to -5 attack to gain an equal dodge bonus to Armor Class until the next action
Deflect Arrows: Can use a free hand to bat away a successful ranged attack, suffering no damage, once per rd
Diehard: Can remain conscious, stable, and able to act with negative hit points; taking a standard action inflicts 1 HP
Great Cleave: Can use Cleave multiple times per rd
Greater Two-Weapon Fighting: Can make a third off-hand attack with a -10 attack penalty
Improved Bull Rush: +4 on Bull Rush attempts, and they provoke no AOO from the target
Improved Disarm: +4 on Disarm attempts, they provoke no AOO, and the target cannot attempt to disarm on failure
Improved Feint: Can Feint as a move action
Improved Grapple: +4 on Grapple checks, and Grapple attempts provoke no AOO
Improved Overrun: +4 on Overrun attempts, and the target cannot avoid them
Improved Precise Shot: Ranged attacks ignore partial cover or concealment, and ranged attacks on a grappled target never hit another in the grapple
Improved Sunder: +4 on Sunder attempts, and they provoke no AOO
Improved Trip: +4 on Trip attempts, they provoke no AOO, and a successful Trip allows an immediate attack on the target
Improved Two-Weapon Fighting: Can make a second off-hand attack with a -5 penalty
Improved Unarmed Strike: Unarmed strikes provoke no AOO and can deal lethal damage
Manyshot: R30' Can fire up to 3 arrows simultaneously at a single target with a -2 attack penalty per arrow
Mobility: +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class vs. movement AOO
Mounted Archery: Reduces the mounted ranged weapon attack penalty to -2 during a double move and -4 during a run
Mounted Combat: Can use a reaction and a successful Ride skill check (DC foe attack roll) to negate damage to mount once per rd
Point-Blank Shot: +1 ranged attack and damage within 30'
Power Attack: Can suffer up to -12 attack for an equal damage bonus for 1 rd; the damage bonus is doubled when attacking two-handed
Precise Shot: Suffers no penalty from shooting into a melee
Rapid Shot: Can make an extra ranged attack during a full attack, suffering a -2 penalty on all ranged attacks during the rd
Ride-By Attack: Can move before and after a mounted attack without provoking AOO, moving in total up to double the normal mounted Speed
Shot On The Run: Can move before and after a ranged attack, moving up to 20' total
Snatch Arrows: Can use Deflect Arrows to catch ranged weapons, and can make an immediate attack with a caught thrown weapon
Spirited Charge: Attacks during a charge inflict double damage, or triple damage with a lance
Spring Attack: Can move before and after a melee attack without provoking an AOO from the target, moving up to 20' total
Stunning Fist: Unarmed Strike can inflict stunned for 1 rd (save Fortitude DC 17 negates) 3 times per day
Trample: Mounted Overrun targets cannot avoid them, and a successful mounted Overrun allows the mount to make a hoof attack vs. the target
Two-Weapon Defense: +1 shield bonus to Armor Class when wielding two weapons, or +2 if fighting defensively
Two-Weapon Fighting: Reduces the attack penalties when fighting with a weapon in each hand by 2 for the primary hand and 6 for the off hand
Whirlwind Attack: Can use a full attack action to make 1 attack vs. all foes within reach
Save: Fortitude: +8; Reflex: +7; Will: +5
